question: How does Arjuna see the whole world in Krishna's body?
premises: Arjuna sees the whole world in one place
The world is divided in many ways
It appears in the body of the god of gods
inference: Arjuna perceives the entire cosmos as contained and divided within Krishna's divine body.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi forms are analyzed as wholes
plain_english: Then Arjuna saw the whole world, divided in many ways, in one place in the body of the god of gods.
